label: Claude A · voxel
about: Blocky voxel figures, one cube size for everything (about 3 cm), face drawn as pixel blocks, glasses as a block frame one voxel off the face. Rigid parts on 7 bones, Minecraft-style swing walk.
attempts: Smaller ID card, headphone cups with teal rings, bigger bun; Eric's hoodie strings and card smaller, more hair volume.
Eric: darker stubble, darker glasses frame, hair down to the nape, bigger ponytail.
Eric's hair combed back in steps instead of a straight fringe.

label: Claude B · toy figure
about: Toy-figure proportions (minifig, Playmobil) from clean primitives: cylinder head with a printed-style face, trapezoid torso, legs that swing from one hip pin, C-clip hands, clip-on hair pieces, glossy plastic.
attempts: First build. Weak: the head's top shows through the hair as a pale band, the teal piece covers Mio's eyes.
Hair pieces bigger, teal piece moved to the back. Weak: the pale band is still there.
Hair pieces fitted closer. Weak: band still on Eric.
Hair pieces wider. Weak: band still on Eric.
Hair raised: band gone, but both hair pieces are tall egg-shaped helmets. Weak.
Head rebuilt as a cylinder with a low dome so the hair can hug it.
Mio's side strand round and tapered, glasses frame bars longer.
Eric's hair sides slope back (combed back); glasses corners no longer show black dots.

label: Claude C · faceted low-poly
about: Tall faceted low-poly, flat-shaded planes, a small head on a long body; silhouette first (Mio an A: a bell-shaped oversized hoodie on thin legs; Eric a V: broad blazer shoulders over a narrow waist). Face is only glasses, eye planes and brows. Knees in the walk.
attempts: First build. Weak: teal frames Mio's face on both sides, Eric's hair sits like a helmet.
Mio's hair opened at the face, teal only at the nape and on her left (image right); smaller eyes; Eric's hairline higher with a lighter combed strip on top.
Glasses bars overlap at the corners (black dots still visible).

label: Codex A · stitched cloth
about: Sewn cloth dolls with broad cloth face panels, continuous seams, padded sleeves and short legs. Seven rigid bones, idle and walk. Includes actual game captures and earlier offline camera studies. The idle and walk clips can lift or sink the feet; static game views are grounded. Attempts, in order: attempt-01: First face, side and pair studies. Pair framing too tight; Eric’s hoodie intersects the jacket. attempt-02: Wider framing, jacket hem stitches, changed Eric hair. Hoodie and lapels sit off the torso. attempt-03: Fitted clothing and combed cloth hair seams. Sparse face stitches resemble facial hair. attempt-04: Continuous face seam and capped curves. A small break remains in Eric’s hoodie panel. attempt-05: Clothing follows the actual torso mesh. Full views and forecourt scale comparison.

label: Codex B · carved puppets
about: Compact carved puppets: short barrel bodies, wedge shoes and shaped cheeks and jaws. Hair is cut into solid angular locks. Detailed faces and short rigid limbs on seven bones, idle and walk. Includes actual game captures and earlier offline camera studies. The idle and walk clips can lift or sink the feet; static game views are grounded. Eric’s beard marks stand away from the face in profile. Attempts, in order: attempt-01: Initial extruded faces and barrel bodies. Pair framing too tight. attempt-02: Wider framing and changed hoodie panel. Blender stopped partway through; generated GLBs and partial images retained. attempt-03: Added cheek and chin depth transitions; fitted clothing. attempt-04: Clothing follows the torso mesh; Mio’s green side hair tapers. Full views and forecourt scale comparison.

label: Codex C · squash cartoon
about: Smooth squash cartoon bodies with pear torsos, narrow bean-shaped faces, large hands and long shoes. Mio has lower eyelids; Eric has a projecting nose. Seven rigid bones with a broader arm swing, idle and walk. Includes actual game captures and earlier offline camera studies. The idle and walk clips can lift or sink the feet; static game views are grounded. Eric’s beard marks stand away from the face in profile. Attempts, in order: attempt-01: First face, side and pair studies. Open hair ends and intersecting hoodie. attempt-02: Closed and tapered hair, lower swept hair on Eric, fitted clothing and wider pair framing. Full views and forecourt scale comparison.
